discussion_pending_membership.behavior: Viewing a discussion with an existing pending group membership leaves accepted_at unset. The helper assigns only @group to its local group; the or alternatives evaluate a discussion/poll group without assigning it. DiscussionsController#show sets @discussion, not @group.

reproduction.expected: Pending membership is redeemed, as intended by the helper call.

discussion_pending_membership.scope: Application behavior is held fixed during this test audit; runtime fix and membership/session review remain outstanding.

queued_group_export_access_revocation.behavior: An ordinary coordinator who loses group membership before a queued JSON or CSV export runs still receives a new blob containing private group data. These workers do not reauthorize the requester. HTML already rechecks export permission.

reproduction.actor: member_normal, explicitly confirmed not an instance administrator
steps: Grant group coordination and prove export permission.
Queue JSON through GroupService.export, or retain the CSV job arguments used by the API.
Revoke the membership through MembershipService and prove current export permission is denied.
Execute the worker and observe a mail to the revoked requester with a blob containing the private group description.

boundaries.revoked_coordinator: JSON and CSV generate and mail the archive after revocation, confirmed.
boundaries.html: Existing regression confirms no email after coordination is removed.
boundaries.operators: Admin::GroupsController intentionally supports exporting discarded groups to an explicit recipient. A fix must preserve this separately authorized operator workflow rather than unconditionally applying the ordinary group-export rule.

queued_group_export_access_revocation.scope: Application code is held fixed during this mutation audit. Execution-time reauthorization and focused regressions remain outstanding for a separate runtime change.

bootstrap_cache_policy.behavior: The bootstrap calls expires_now and then prevent_caching, whose raw Cache-Control header requests no-store. Rails response normalization uses the no-cache directive retained by expires_now and the final response omits no-store.

reproduction.request: GET /dashboard through ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest and the full Rack stack
reproduction.expected: Cache-Control includes no-store, as requested by prevent_caching.

bootstrap_cache_policy.scope: This confirms the missing storage prohibition, not whether a particular browser or proxy stores the page. No user-data disclosure is claimed. Application code stays fixed during the mutation audit; a separate fix should reconcile the shared cache policy with Rails response.cache_control.

customized_builtin_template_original_vis.behavior: Creating a customized copy of a built-in poll template clears the saved copy key but only adds the built-in key to group.hidden_poll_templates in memory. The group setting is not saved, so the original remains visible on a subsequent request.

reproduction.request: Authenticated POST Api::V1::PollTemplatesController#create with built-in key consent and valid customized poll template attributes
reproduction.observed: HTTP success, one saved custom template with nil key; group.reload.hidden_poll_templates remains empty
reproduction.expected: The original consent template stays hidden after reloading the group.

customized_builtin_template_original_vis.scope: User-visible template persistence issue, not an established access disclosure. Application code remains fixed during mutation comparisons; a separate fix must save both the copy and group setting atomically.
